name: MEDVED 🐻‍❄️ (Hunt & Become Bears)
desc:
⚔️ Find and Hunt the Mutant Bears A.K.A. Medveds. 
🐻‍❄️ Or become a bear yourself and hunt the players down...

🗺️ Explore, discover their story and collect items in a large snowy world. 
🔍 Uncover the secret of the bears and why they are here. 
🐻‍❄️ Discover many bear mutations and variants... Some are more dangerous than others

llm.loop: explore a large snowy world -> hunt mutant bears with guns and items -> discover lore and variants -> optionally become a bear
llm.objectives: hunt all Medved variants and uncover secrets
llm.instructions: hunt mutant bears, explore, become a bear
unique: play as either hunter or mutant bear
llm.thumbnails: gaping-mouth mutant bears; player shooting bears in snow
llm.complexity_notes: large snowy world, creature AI, bear playable
